parameters.name: consumerGroup
parameters.description: The name of the consumer group.

parameters.name: shard
parameters.description:
The shard ID.

*   If the specified shard does not exist, an empty list is returned.
*   If no shard ID is specified, the checkpoints of all shards are returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sls get-check-point --project ali-test-project --logstore test-logstore --consumer-group consumer-group-1 --shard 1 --region cn-hangzhou
